reviews.title: Great Waterproof Pet Crate Pad
reviews.body: I have a puppy who has occasional accidents in her crate and needed a waterproof  crate pad.  This pad is truly waterproof.  I simply wipe down the pad with pet urine cleaner spray and the pad dries quickly.  The pad cover is not 100% stain proof, however, as a few small stains have remained.  The foam pad is also thick as described and supportive.  Highly recommend this pad.
reviews.date: Reseñado en Estados Unidos el 3 de mayo de 2026
